title: Racket Arm
intro: Twelve minutes on the arm that plays the sport: forearm, elbow and shoulder.

It opens at the forearm rather than the elbow, because that is where tennis elbow actually starts — the muscles that grip the racket and brake the wrist on every shot, with the elbow just the place they attach and complain.

before.label: Stop and get it looked at
before.text: Tingling or numbness into your fingers, a grip that suddenly fails, pain after a fall or a wrench, swelling, an elbow that locks or won't straighten, or pain that wakes you at night.

before.label: Never roll
before.text: Your lower back, the front or side of your neck, the back of your knee, the inside of your elbow, your armpit or right into the groin crease. Nothing that's swollen, hot, bruised or freshly hurt.

before.label: Leave that spot alone
before.text: If something grabbed during play and it's still sore now, leave it alone and get it looked at. If it's sharp, or you get pins and needles, back off.

good: Forearm across the roller, slow from elbow to wrist, top side first
Open and close your fist while you pause on a sore spot
bad: Rolling straight over the bony point of the elbow

good: Arm straight, palm down, bend the wrist so the fingers point down
Feel the top of the forearm
bad: Pulling hard — this one is easy to overdo

good: Arm straight, palm up, bend the wrist so the fingers point down
Feel the underside of the forearm

exercises.name: Lat Roll
exercises.note: Your serving side will be the worse one, so give it the extra time.

good: On your side, arm overhead, roller under the armpit
Small movements, pause where it bites
Roller across the upper back, hands behind the head, ribs down
Pause and breathe at each level
Arm straight across the chest, pull it in with the other forearm
Shoulder stays down, not shrugged to the ear
bad: Pushing into a pinch at the front of the shoulder

good: Forearm on the door frame, elbow at shoulder height, step through and turn away
Feel it across the front of the chest
bad: Letting the shoulder roll forward into it
